# obot_mcp_catalog_source (Resource)

Manages one source of the default MCP catalog, as adding a source in the Obot UI does. Other sources, including ones added in the UI, are left unchanged. The source owns the entries it provides. Creating, changing, or destroying a source waits up to five minutes for a new catalog sync. Destroy removes only this source; Obot then removes the entries it provided, while running servers and API-created entries are kept. A source that already exists in Obot must be imported. See the [catalog and access-policy guide](../guides/catalogs-and-access-policies.md).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "obot_mcp_catalog_source" "team" {
  url = "https://github.com/example/obot-catalog/tree/main/mcp"

  # For a private source, reference an existing Obot Git credential:
  # git_credential_id = "gc1example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `url` (String) Complete HTTPS URL of the catalog source, including any Git ref and subdirectory. Changing it replaces the source. Also the import identifier.

### Optional

- `git_credential_id` (String) ID of an existing Obot Git credential used to read a private source. When unset, Obot keeps any token stored for the source in the UI; Terraform never reads it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The source URL, which identifies the source.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = obot_mcp_catalog_source.team
  identity = {
    url = "https://github.com/example/obot-catalog/tree/main/mcp"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `url` (String) The catalog source URL.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = obot_mcp_catalog_source.team
  id = "https://github.com/example/obot-catalog/tree/main/mcp"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import obot_mcp_catalog_source.team https://github.com/example/obot-catalog/tree/main/mcp
```
